content: Sell-side mandate: advising on the sale of a founder-owned industrial manufacturing business. Teaser available under NDA. On behalf of our client.
Acquisition mandate: we are looking to acquire a manufacturing platform in western India. Add-on acquisition criteria are ₹40-150 crore revenue and no institutional capital today.
Interesting year for mergers in Indian manufacturing. A few processes launched, nothing I am running.
We are hiring a head of M&A. Apply if you have closed two deals.
